audience: teams that collect field and office paperwork in GoFormz, such as inspections, work orders and delivery receipts

useCases.title: Find completed forms for a template
useCases.text: The AI lists the forms of one template by status and last update, and opens a form to show every field value.

useCases.title: Create and assign a draft form
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft form from a template, pre-fills the fields you give it and assigns it to a user or group.

useCases.title: Correct a form's field values
useCases.text: The AI changes the name or selected field values of a form. Only the fields you name change, and the status stays as it was.

useCases.title: Export a finished form to PDF
useCases.text: The AI starts the PDF export of a form, waits for the job to finish and returns the temporary download link.

useCases.title: Keep dropdown lookup tables up to date
useCases.text: The AI reads a data source and its rows, then adds a row or replaces one (every column is sent), so dropdowns in your templates show current values.

useCases.title: Reopen or complete a form
useCases.text: The AI sets a completed form back to draft so it can be edited, or marks a draft complete. Completing can start the template's workflows and webhooks.
